description: This file is a PHP web page that provides a user interface for troubleshooting actions on a gateway device, including reset and restore functions. It includes external PHP includes for header, footer, and navigation, and contains embedded JavaScript for handling user interactions and AJAX requests to perform device resets and reboots.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to reset or restore the device based on user interaction, and manages UI feedback during the process.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by attempting to access index.php, and redirects to login page upon success.
